description: Simulation Dataset for Evaluating Evacuation Shelter Location Impacts on Water Access During Seismic Events is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Jason Poff. This contains the data and code used in a paper with the following abstract: "Supplying potable water and other services to critical facilities such as hospitals and evacuation shelters is crucial following disasters. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
